d: Company Description Dusit Doha Hotel and Dusit Hotel & Suites – Doha bring Dusit International’s renowned Thai hospitality and five-star luxury to the heart of West Bay, Doha. Located near the Corniche and major shopping destinations, both properties offer upscale accommodations with floor-to-ceiling windows and modern amenities. Guests can enjoy diverse dining experiences, including fine dining venues, a cigar lounge, and the Tropicana 360 rooftop restaurant and bar. The hotels feature state-of-the-art wellness facilities, such as a fitness centre and indoor swimming pool, providing an enriching stay for business and leisure travelers. Team members join a dynamic environment focused on outstanding guest experiences, professional service, and continuous improvement.

Role Description The Bartender role is a full-time, on-site position based in Doha at Dusit Doha Hotel | Dusit Hotel & Suites – Doha. The Bartender will prepare and serve a wide range of beverages, including cocktails, mocktails, wines, and spirits, ensuring consistent quality and presentation that align with brand standards. Daily responsibilities include greeting guests, taking orders, providing recommendations, and delivering attentive service at the bar and related service areas. The Bartender will manage bar setup and closing duties, maintain cleanliness and hygiene, restock supplies, and ensure proper storage of beverages and garnishes. The role also includes accurate cash handling and POS transactions, adherence to local regulations and hotel policies, collaboration with the food and beverage team, and support for special events and promotions.
q: Strong customer service and communication skills to engage guests, handle inquiries, and resolve issues professionally.
Hands-on experience in bartending and food & beverage service, including cocktail preparation, menu knowledge, and bar operations.
Accurate cash handling skills and familiarity with POS systems to process payments and maintain financial records.
Knowledge of beverage safety, hygiene standards, and local regulations related to alcohol service.
Previous experience in a hotel, luxury bar, or restaurant environment is preferred.
Ability to stand for extended periods, work shifts, weekends, and holidays as required.
Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Formal training or certification in bartending or food & beverage service is beneficial.
